description: Bind videos to an AI assistant (Tutor). Additive: only videos not yet bound are added; videos already bound stay as they are and nothing is unbound (use panda_remove_tutor_video to remove one). Only CONVERTED videos: if any ID doesn't exist or isn't CONVERTED, the whole request is refused. Billing: each NEW video without a subtitle in the tutor's language gets a transcription, charged at ceil(minutes/5) credits per video (Gold/Enterprise plans outside trial get free transcriptions up to a daily limit); without enough credits the API refuses before binding anything.

lang.description: Language code; only used when the tutor has no language set

name: panda_update_ai_assistant_video_bindings
title: Update AI Assistant Video Bindings
